name: step_form
label: Form (step 1)
help_text: The HubSpot form buyers fill in before paying. Its email field is passed to Stripe as prefilled_email.

name: stripe_link
label: Stripe Link
help_text: The live Stripe Payment Link (https://buy.stripe.com/... or your custom checkout domain). Its confirmation behavior must be 'redirect' or no UTMs are captured.

name: button_label
label: Submit button label
help_text: Replaces the form's own submit text. Also used on the fallback pay button.

name: prefill_email
label: Prefill email on Stripe
help_text: Adds prefilled_email to the Stripe link so the payment matches the HubSpot contact. Stripe shows a prefilled email read-only.

name: open_new_tab
label: Open checkout in a new tab
help_text: Usually leave off: the redirect runs after an async submit, so browsers often block the new tab (the module then falls back to the same tab).

name: test_mode
label: Test mode
help_text: Uses Test Stripe Link and shows a TEST MODE banner to everyone. Never falls back to the live link.

name: test_stripe_link
label: Test Stripe Link
help_text: Stripe test-mode payment link. Only used when Test mode is on.
